---
format:
  typst:
    output-file: Barbone-Compact-Resume.pdf
    papersize: us-letter
    margin: 
      x: "0.75in"
      y: "0.75in"
    footer: false
    numbering: false
    keep-typ: true
    template-partials:
      - typst-template.typ
execute:
  echo: false 
params:
  metadata_file: "../_metadata.yaml"
  bib_packages: "../bib/packages.bib"
---

```{r}
#| labels: functions
typst_string <- function(x) {
  jsonlite::toJSON(as.character(x %||% ""), auto_unbox = TRUE)
}

linkify_urls <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x %||% "")

  # DOI URLs -> concise DOI labels
  x <- gsub(
    "(?<!\\()\\bhttps?://(?:dx\\.)?doi\\.org/(?:doi/)?([A-Za-z0-9._;()/:+-]+)",
    "[doi:\\1](https://doi.org/\\1)",
    x,
    perl = TRUE
  )

  # Other bare URLs -> standard markdown links
  gsub(
    "(?<!\\()\\b(https?://[A-Za-z0-9./?=&_%#:+~-]*[A-Za-z0-9/_#])",
    "[\\1](\\1)",
    x,
    perl = TRUE
  )
}

pandoc_md_to_typst <- function(x) {
  x <- linkify_urls(as.character(x %||% ""))
  in_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".md")
  out_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".typ")

  writeLines(x, in_file)
  rmarkdown::pandoc_convert(
    input = in_file,
    to = "typst",
    output = out_file,
    options = c("--wrap=none")
  )

  paste(readLines(out_file, warn = FALSE), collapse = "\n")
}

bullet_items <- function(text, max_bullets = 5) {
  if (is.null(text)) {
    return(character())
  }

  lines <- strsplit(as.character(text), "\\n", fixed = FALSE)[[1]]
  lines <- trimws(lines)
  lines <- lines[nzchar(lines)]
  head(lines, max_bullets)
}

bullet_items_condensed <- function(highlights, accomplishments, max_bullets = 3) {
  if (!is.null(highlights) && nzchar(trimws(as.character(highlights)))) {
    return(bullet_items(highlights, max_bullets = max_bullets))
  }

  lines <- bullet_items(accomplishments, max_bullets = 100)
  if (length(lines) == 0) {
    return(character())
  }

  supervision_pattern <- paste(
    c("supervis", "supervision", "train", "mentoring", "managed?\\s+team", "onboard"),
    collapse = "|"
  )

  keep <- !grepl(supervision_pattern, tolower(lines), perl = TRUE)
  filtered <- lines[keep]

  if (length(filtered) == 0) {
    filtered <- lines
  }

  head(filtered, max_bullets)
}

to_typst_content <- function(x) {
  paste0("[", pandoc_md_to_typst(x), "]")
}

emit_group_items <- function(title, items) {
  items <- as.character(items)
  items <- items[nzchar(trimws(items))]

  out <- c(
    "  (",
    paste0("    title: ", to_typst_content(title), ","),
    "    body: ["
  )

  for (it in items) {
    out <- c(out, paste0("      - ", pandoc_md_to_typst(it)))
  }

  c(out, "    ],", "  ),")
}

emit_named_groups <- function(groups) {
  out <- c("(")

  for (g in groups) {
    out <- c(out, emit_group_items(g$title, g$items))
  }

  out <- c(out, ")")
  paste(out, collapse = "\n")
}

experience_item <- function(item) {
  bullets <- bullet_items_condensed(item$highlights, item$accomplishments, max_bullets = 3)

  out <- c(
    "  (",
    paste0("    org: ", to_typst_content(item$company), ","),
    paste0("    location: ", to_typst_content(item$location), ","),
    paste0("    role: ", to_typst_content(item$position), ","),
    paste0("    dates: ", to_typst_content(item$period), ","),
    "    bullets: ("
  )

  for (b in bullets) {
    out <- c(out, paste0("      ", to_typst_content(b), ","))
  }

  c(out, "    ),", "  ),")
}

education_item <- function(item) {
  c(
    "  (",
    paste0("    org: ", to_typst_content(item$institution), ","),
    paste0("    credential: ", to_typst_content(item$degree), ","),
    paste0("    location: ", to_typst_content(item$location), ","),
    paste0("    dates: ", to_typst_content(item$period), ","),
    "  ),"
  )
}

skills_item <- function(name, details) {
  c(
    "  (",
    paste0("    name: ", to_typst_content(name), ","),
    paste0("    details: ", to_typst_content(details), ","),
    "  ),"
  )
}

read_package_links <- function(bib_file) {
  bib <- RefManageR::ReadBib(bib_file)

  items <- lapply(bib, function(entry) {
    key <- names(entry)
    title <- as.character(entry[[key]]$title %||% "")
    pkg <- trimws(sub(":.*$", "", title))
    url <- as.character(entry[[key]]$url %||% "")

    if (!nzchar(pkg) || !nzchar(url)) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    list(name = pkg, url = url)
  })

  items <- Filter(Negate(is.null), items)
  unique(items)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: data
meta <- yaml::read_yaml(params$metadata_file)
experience <- meta$experience
education <- meta$education
skills <- meta$skills
package_links <- read_package_links(params$bib_packages)

parse_month_year <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x %||% ""))
  if (!nzchar(x)) {
    return(as.Date("1900-01-01"))
  }

  x_low <- tolower(x)
  if (x_low %in% c("present", "current")) {
    return(as.Date("9999-12-31"))
  }

  parts <- strsplit(x, "\\s+")[[1]]
  if (length(parts) < 2) {
    return(as.Date("1900-01-01"))
  }

  month_num <- match(parts[1], month.abb)
  year_num <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(parts[2]))

  if (is.na(month_num) || is.na(year_num)) {
    return(as.Date("1900-01-01"))
  }

  as.Date(sprintf("%04d-%02d-01", year_num, month_num))
}

extract_end_date <- function(when) {
  bounds <- strsplit(as.character(when %||% ""), "\\s*-\\s*")[[1]]
  end_part <- if (length(bounds) >= 2) bounds[2] else bounds[1]
  parse_month_year(end_part)
}

extract_start_date <- function(when) {
  bounds <- strsplit(as.character(when %||% ""), "\\s*-\\s*")[[1]]
  start_part <- bounds[1]
  parse_month_year(start_part)
}

if (length(experience) > 0) {
  end_dates <- vapply(experience, function(x) extract_end_date(x$period), as.Date("1970-01-01"))
  start_dates <- vapply(experience, function(x) extract_start_date(x$period), as.Date("1970-01-01"))
  ord <- order(end_dates, start_dates, decreasing = TRUE)
  experience <- experience[ord]
}

experience <- head(experience, 3)
```

```{r}
#| label: prep output
out <- c(
  "// Auto-generated from YAML sources. Do not edit manually.",
  "#import \"typst-template.typ\": *",
  "",
  paste0("#let cv_given = ", typst_string(meta$given)),
  paste0("#let cv_surname = ", typst_string(meta$surname)),
  paste0("#let cv_location = ", typst_string(meta$location)),
  paste0("#let cv_phone = ", typst_string(meta$phone)),
  paste0("#let cv_email = ", typst_string(meta$email)),
  paste0("#let cv_web = ", typst_string(meta$web)),
  paste0("#let cv_github = ", typst_string(meta$github)),
  paste0("#let cv_linkedin = ", typst_string(meta$linkedin)),
  "",
  "#let experience_data = ("
)

for (item in experience) {
  out <- c(out, experience_item(item))
}

out <- c(out, ")", "", "#let education_data = (")

for (i in seq_along(education)) {
  item <- education[[i]]
  out <- c(out, education_item(item))
}

out <- c(out, ")", "", "#let skills_data = (")
for (s in skills) {
  out <- c(out, skills_item(s$name, s$details))
}

package_parts <- vapply(
  package_links,
  function(x) paste0("[", x$name, "](", x$url, ")"),
  NA_character_
)
packages_line <- paste(package_parts, collapse = " | ")

out <- c(
  out,
  ")",
  "",
  paste0("#let packages_line = ", to_typst_content(packages_line)),
  "",
  "#render_compact_resume(",
  "  cv_given,",
  "  cv_surname,",
  "  cv_location,",
  "  cv_phone,",
  "  cv_email,",
  "  cv_web,",
  "  cv_github,",
  "  cv_linkedin,",
  "  experience_data,",
  "  education_data,",
  "  skills_data,",
  "  packages_line,",
  ")"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: output
#| results: asis
cat("```{=typst}\n", paste(out, collapse = "\n"), "\n```\n", sep = "")
```
